feladatok.cim: Email to Jeff about a rock climbing trip
feladatok.helyzet: During your stay in the US your American friend, Jeff, sent you a brochure about a rock climbing trip which he wants to take part in, asking you if you would like to join him.

bekezdesek: These trips emphasize developing individual climbing technique and skills. They are based on a hands-on approach and are conducted in an amazing alpine setting. Towering peaks and glaciers provide a spectacular backdrop and great terrain to develop climbing skills. Our programs provide an excellent introduction to rock climbing for beginners and valuable practice for more advanced climbers. Our low client to guide ratio allows us the flexibility to accommodate individual goals and expectations. All climbing equipment is provided.

feladatok.teendo: Write an email of 120-150 words in which you
iranyito_szempontok: Ask about the destination, the length and the price of the trip Jeff has chosen
Say what you like about the idea and what your worries are
Say if you would like to take part and why

bekezdesek: A Home Rules Contract is a written set of expectations that parents have of their teens. The contract includes basic rules, consequences and privileges. The final contract should be the result of negotiation and compromise, taking everybody's ideas into consideration.
